scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w addin
scripts.dev: npm run build -w api && (npm run dev -w api & npm run dev -w addin)
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w api && npm run test -w addin
scripts.typecheck:test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npm run typecheck:test -w addin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w addin && npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w shared
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:test && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.corpus: npm run build -w shared && node scripts/corpus.mjs
